review:
Wild Booster is a 3x5, 20-payline slot with classic symbols and two dynamic features. The wild can randomly boost wins with a multiplier worth up to 100x the bet, giving the base game occasional big moments.

Free spins come in progressive tiers. Each set of five scatters increases the total multiplier in Super Boost Free Spins, and higher tiers raise the stakes further: up to 50x in Ultra Boost and up to 100x in Mega Boost free games. The advertised maximum is 5,000x and the RTP is 96.47%. It combines a classic look with modern multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
